candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory spans error at 1350ms with 9 redis_operation_timeout 504 log entries and 18 dependency_timeouts, propagating to gateway's errored 'call inventory' span (1947ms). This bounds a redis-timeout root cause on the inventory->redis path.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (server latency, saturation) not observed; deployment record cannot establish causation.

report.explanation: Traces, logs, and metrics converge on redis timeouts inside inventory propagating to gateway. Gateway metrics/logs look healthy, so the fault is bounded to the inventory->redis dependency. Deployment record is non-causal. Redis-side telemetry is still needed to confirm the timeout origin.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics for the incident window
Inventory error-rate metric confirming elevated errors beyond the 0.001 sample
